# Divine

> Divine is a reseller community that helps members find what to buy, where to buy it, and how to resell it for a profit.

## Public Pages

- [Home](/): Public landing page for Divine, including community proof, membership details, FAQs, and calls to start a free trial.

## Key Information

- Divine serves resellers across categories including eBay, Amazon, sneakers, Pokemon, tickets, and more.
- Membership includes access to the Divine Discord, Sneaker Discord, and Trading & Sports Betting Discord.
- The page includes testimonials and results from Divine members. Individual results vary and are not guaranteed.
- The public page is separate from the private visual editor at `/editor`.

## Not For Indexing

- `/editor`: Private visual editor route.
- `/cms`: Removed/unsupported legacy CMS route.
